mapper.select: SELECT B.BABY_ID, B.NAME, TO_CHAR(B.BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, B.GENDER, B.FEED_REMIND_HOURS, B.LAST_REMIND_LOG_ID, B.CREATED_BY, M.RELATION, M.IS_OWNER, M.NOTIFY_ACTIVITY, M.NOTIFY_REMIND FROM TBABY_BABY B JOIN TBABY_MEMBER M ON M.BABY_ID = B.BABY_ID WHERE M.KAKAO_ID = #{kakaoId} AND B.IS_HIDDEN = 0 ORDER BY B.BABY_ID
SELECT BABY_ID, NAME, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, FEED_REMIND_HOURS, LAST_REMIND_LOG_ID, CREATED_BY FROM TBABY_BABY WHERE BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT TBABY_BABY_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBABY_BABY (BABY_ID, NAME, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, FEED_REMIND_HOURS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, IS_HIDDEN) VALUES (#{babyId}, #{name}, TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{feedRemindHours}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBABY_BABY SET NAME = #{name}, BIRTH_DATE = TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), GENDER = #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FEED_REMIND_HOURS = #{feedRemindHours} WHERE BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
UPDATE TBABY_BABY SET IS_HIDDEN = 1 WHERE BABY_ID = #{babyId}
mapper.select: SELECT BABY_ID, NAME, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, FEED_REMIND_HOURS, LAST_REMIND_LOG_ID, CREATED_BY FROM TBABY_BABY WHERE FEED_REMIND_HOURS > 0 AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE TBABY_BABY SET LAST_REMIND_LOG_ID = #{logId} WHERE BABY_ID = #{babyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBABY_MEMBER (BABY_ID, KAKAO_ID, RELATION, NOTIFY_ACTIVITY, NOTIFY_REMIND, IS_OWNER, JOINED_AT) VALUES (#{babyId}, #{kakaoId}, #{relation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', 'Y', #{isOwner}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT M.BABY_ID, M.KAKAO_ID, U.NICKNAME, M.RELATION, M.NOTIFY_ACTIVITY, M.NOTIFY_REMIND, M.IS_OWNER FROM TBABY_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TCAR_USER_KAKAO U ON U.KAKAO_ID = M.KAKAO_ID WHERE M.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND M.KAKAO_ID = #{kakaoId}

SELECT M.BABY_ID, M.KAKAO_ID, U.NICKNAME, M.RELATION, M.NOTIFY_ACTIVITY, M.NOTIFY_REMIND, M.IS_OWNER FROM TBABY_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TCAR_USER_KAKAO U ON U.KAKAO_ID = M.KAKAO_ID WHERE M.BABY_ID = #{babyId} ORDER BY M.IS_OWNER DESC, M.JOINED_AT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBABY_MEMBER WHERE BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND KAKAO_ID = #{kakaoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBABY_INVITE (CODE, BABY_ID, CREATED_BY, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (#{code}, #{babyId}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE + #{hours} / 24)
mapper.select: SELECT BABY_ID FROM TBABY_INVITE WHERE CODE = #{code} AND USED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TBABY_INVITE SET USED_BY = #{kakaoId}, USED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CODE = #{code} AND USED_AT IS NULL AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSDATE
mapper.sql: L.LOG_ID, L.BABY_ID, L.LOG_TYPE, TO_CHAR(L.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_AT, TO_CHAR(L.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_AT, L.ML, L.DETAIL, L.WEIGHT_KG, L.HEIGHT_CM, L.HEAD_CM, L.TEMP_C, L.MEMO, L.CREATED_BY, NVL(M.RELATION, U.NICKNAME) AS CREATED_BY_NAME
FROM TBABY_LOG L LEFT JOIN TBABY_MEMBER M ON M.BABY_ID = L.BABY_ID AND M.KAKAO_ID = L.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN TCAR_USER_KAKAO U ON U.KAKAO_ID = L.CREATED_BY
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE L.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND L.IS_HIDDEN = 0 AND L.START_AT < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AND ( NVL(L.END_AT, L.START_AT) >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') OR (L.LOG_TYPE = 'SLEEP' AND L.END_AT IS NULL) ) ORDER BY L.START_AT, L.LOG_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
WHERE L.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND L.IS_HIDDEN = 0 AND L.LOG_TYPE IN ('FORMULA', 'BREAST') ORDER BY L.START_AT DESC, L.LOG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
WHERE L.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND L.IS_HIDDEN = 0 AND L.LOG_TYPE = 'SLEEP' AND L.END_AT IS NULL ORDER BY L.START_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
WHERE L.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND L.IS_HIDDEN = 0 AND L.LOG_TYPE = 'SLEEP' AND L.END_AT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY L.END_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT
WHERE L.BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND L.IS_HIDDEN = 0 AND L.LOG_TYPE = 'GROWTH' ORDER BY L.START_AT, L.LOG_ID
mapper.insert:
SELECT TBABY_LOG_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBABY_LOG ( LOG_ID, BABY_ID, LOG_TYPE, START_AT, END_AT, ML, DETAIL, WEIGHT_KG, HEIGHT_CM, HEAD_CM, TEMP_C, MEMO, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, IS_HIDDEN ) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{babyId}, #{logType}, TO_DATE(#{startAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{endAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), #{ml, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{detail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{weightKg, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{heightCm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{headCm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tempC, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBABY_LOG SET LOG_TYPE = #{logType}, START_AT = TO_DATE(#{startAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), END_AT = TO_DATE(#{endAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ML = #{ml, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DETAIL = #{detail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WEIGHT_KG = #{weightKg, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, HEIGHT_CM = #{heightCm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, HEAD_CM = #{headCm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TEMP_C = #{tempC, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MEMO = #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId} AND BABY_ID = #{babyId} AND IS_HIDDEN = 0
UPDATE TBABY_LOG SET IS_HIDDEN = 1 WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId} AND BABY_ID = #{babyId}
